explanation: Implemented all seven B04 edits using pinned revision 936f7b72afef2f9b736180d57c1d42281b3063e4. Selection now shows gesture arbitration, explicit node membership and native synchronization. The current reducer permits whole-diagram and region coexistence, superseding the earlier exclusion rules; runtime arrows now appear above shapes. The structured composer connects pinned references, templates, create/edit/extend generation, retained outputs and acknowledged installation. All trees fit their scaffold bounds; Runtime and Composer contain exactly 36 and 32 concept lines. These changes establish the selection and request lifecycle for later retained-context and variant work without depicting those features or direct atomic edit batches.

Gesture arbitration and unified semantic selection
|-- CanvasSession.SelectionState: committed application membership
|   |-- items[]: ordered, unique id / displayNodeId
|   |-- No region = whole diagram; region = captured node membership
|   |   |-- sourceContentId / sourceRevisionId / captured ASCII
|   |   `-- rect envelope / contentNodeIds / mapped selectedIds
|   `-- Explicit IDs preserve holes; legacy rects resolve once
|-- SelectionCommands: replace / add / toggleDiagram / remove / clear
|   |-- Equivalent regions reuse identity; add preserves order
|   |-- Whole + region may coexist: replaces old exclusion rule
|   |-- replace clears prior items; toggle removes only whole item
|   `-- Deselect restores no regions; panels do not own membership
|-- CanvasSelectionLayer owns SelectionGestureController
|   |-- DOM hit -> diagram/node/revision + pointer/tool/modifiers
|   |-- Mouse: Ctrl without Meta -> additive marquee
|   |   |-- Stationary Ctrl-node -> toggleSubtreeSelection()
|   |   |   `-- Root chooses add/remove; folded descendants follow
|   |   |-- Plain node tap -> captured node region; move -> native
|   |   `-- Shift without Meta blocks; other hits use native tool
|   |-- Pen: Select -> replace marquee/tap; Hand -> pan/tap
|   |-- Touch -> temporary Hand pan/pinch; no selection completion
|   |   `-- Multiple contacts cancel move; latch until all release
|   |-- Non-node double-click -> replace diagram; Ctrl/Meta -> toggle
|   `-- Escape/cancel/blur/tool change -> discard preview
|-- SelectionToolBridge: CanvasRuntime owns tool arbitration
|   |-- MappingSelectTool / MappingHandTool consult bridge
|   |-- Claimed pointer events suppressed; touch still pans/pinches
|   |-- Move handle -> native translation; retain app membership
|   `-- NativeSelectionOwnership: application/native latch
|       |-- Native hit or node drag may claim native ownership
|       `-- App claim survives release; default settle reads latch
|-- GesturePreview: temporary bounds + promoted diagram outlines
|   |-- Pointer moves -> resolve marquee; no membership commit
|   `-- Pointer-up -> completeMarquee(add/replace)
|       |-- Whole hits skip redundant regions in this completion
|       `-- Capture regions; reuse identities and display surfaces
|-- MappingEditorRuntime: whole-shape synchronization
|   |-- Whole IDs -> writeShapes() -> native selectedShapeIds
|   |-- Store listener marks dirty; pointing/dragging/pinch wait
|   |-- Idle settle captures unless domain projection is pending
|   |-- syncNativeDiagramSelection() preserves region membership
|   |   `-- Changed selection + geometry -> commitEditorGesture()
|   `-- Forced pre-command settle skips capture; projects app IDs
|-- Consumers read committed SelectionState
|   |-- Highlights / count / toolbar / copy / move / code / chat
|   |-- selectionClipboardText(): indented rows + selected code refs
|   |   `-- selectionExcerpt(): omitted node holes stay omitted
|   |-- MappingPage -> pinned prompt references [C02 Composer]
|   `-- WebSocket serializer -> initial snapshot -> deltas
|       |-- diagramIds from whole items
|       |-- regions: IDs / source / rect / text / stale
|       `-- Server selection mirror -> connected readers
|-- syncSelectionPresentation(): shared by state writers
|   `-- Captured regions -> reusable display nodes + action surfaces
|-- UI interaction state: action-menu / keyboard focus
`-- PanelState: independent lifetime; survives selection removal

    |-- Layout / expansion / focus stay with panels
    `-- Panel select-source -> captured region selection

[D1] Structured generation request
|-- Dispatch operation: edit-diagram / create-diagram / extend-diagram
|-- Target: sessionId live attachment / nodeId diagram (canvas for create)
|-- Preconditions: expectedVersion / baseRevisionId (empty on canvas create)
|-- Instruction: prompt text; [ref N] indexes references[N-1]
|-- template?: id / version / options / optional edited markdown
|   `-- Catalog operation, option values and placeholders validated
|-- references?: <=20 revision-pinned diagram or nodes references
|   |-- label / diagramId / revisionId
|   `-- nodes: nodeIds (<=500) + start/end line/column range
|-- Scope: subtree? {contentNodeId, revisionId}; create count? 1..4
|-- Placement: origin? {column,row} / sources? content-node anchors
|   `-- Extend requires origin + 1..500 sources; emits one new diagram
`-- requestId per session; agentContextId? -> scoped uploaded snapshot [D3]

[D2] Generation runs and retained outputs

|   `-- Input + AgentContextSnapshot [D3]

|   |-- generating -> applying -> completed
|   |-- Abort only generating -> cancelled
|   |-- VERSION_CONFLICT -> conflict; other -> failed
|   `-- Apply timeout/unavailable/persistence pending

|-- Retained output: reuse without model rerun
